bite.name: Bite

Attacks of that type deal 1d6 points of ‹rule/bleed› damage." special="This evolution can be selected more than once. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a different attack. The bleed effect doesn't stack."}

claws.name: Claws
description: ::ab{title="&L&Claws (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee prereq="‹evolution/Limbs›" ability="An eidolon has a pair of vicious claws at the end of its limbs, giving it two ‹umr/claw attack«s›. These attacks are primary attacks. The claws deal 1d4 points of damage (1d6 if Large, 1d8 if Huge)." special="This evolution can only be applied to the *limbs (legs)* evolution once. This evolution can be selected more than once, but the eidolon must possess an equal number of the *limbs* evolution."}
;;;aside

[FAQ](http://paizo.com/paizo/faq/v5748nruor1fo#v5748eaic9rdk) (link opens in outside browser) If you are a bipedal creature (roughly humanoid-shaped, with two arms and two legs), your claws must go on your hands; you can not assign them to any other limb or body part.

If you are a quadruped (or have more than four legs), you can have claws on your feet. If you have claws on all of your feet, normally you can't use all of those claw attacks on your turn unless you have a special ability such as ‹umr/pounce› or ‹umr/rake›.

Talons are much like claws, but go on a creature's feet, usually a bipedal creature (especially a flying bipedal creature such as a ‹monster/giant eagle› or ‹monster/harpy›). An ability that grants you claw attacks cannot be used as if they were talon attacks (in other words, you can't "re-skin" the ability's game mechanics so you can use it on a different limb).

low_light_vision.name: Low-Light Vision

reach.name: Reach

resistance.name: Resistance

Its effects do not stack. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a different energy type."}

slam.name: Slam

ability_increase.name: Ability Increase

Eidolons with this evolution receive a +4 bonus on CMB checks made to grapple."}

head.name: Head
description: ::ab{title="&L&Head (Ex)&FN&" icon=power ability="An eidolon grows an additional head. immunity.name: Immunity
description: ::ab{title="&L&Immunity (Su)&FN&" icon=def prereq="7th-level summoner" flavor="An eidolon's body becomes extremely resilient to one energy type." passive="Pick one energy type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. keen_scent.name: Keen Scent
description: ::ab{title="&L&Keen Scent (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost prereq="‹evolution/Gills›, ‹evolution/scent›" ability="An eidolon's sense of smell becomes even more acute. limbs.name: Limbs
description: ::ab{title="&L&Limbs (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-boost ability="An eidolon grows an additional pair of limbs. These limbs can take one of two forms.~~~They can be made into legs, complete with feet. Each pair of legs increases the eidolon's base speed by 10 feet.~~~Alternatively, they can be made into arms, complete with hands. The eidolon does not gain any additional natural attacks for an additional pair of arms, but it can take other evolutions that add additional attacks (such as ‹evolution/claws› or a ‹evolution/slam›). Arms that have hands can be used to wield weapons, if the eidolon is proficient." special="This evolution can be selected more than once."}

minor_magic.name: Minor Magic

The caster level for this evolution is equal to the eidolon's Hit Dice - 2. The save DC for this spell is 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Charisma modifier." imp7="This spell can be cast three times per day by spending 2 additional evolution points." special="This evolution can be selected more than once. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a new spell from the above list."}

poison.name: Poison
description: :::ab{title="&L&Poison (Ex)&FN&" prereq="7th-level summoner, eidolon has a bite or sting attack" icon=melee action=Ability}
An eidolon secretes toxic venom, gaining a poison attack. Pick one bite or sting attack. Whenever the selected attack hits, the target is poisoned.
::aff[Eidolon poison]{iconP type="Natural attack-injury" dcF dcHD=eidolon dcIt=its dcMod=Con freqR=4 effStr="1d4" cure1}
For 2 additional evolution points, this poison deals Constitution damage instead. This poison can be used no more than once per round.

rake.name: Rake
description: ::ab{title="&L&Rake (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee prereq="4th-level summoner, eidolon has quadruped base form" ability="An eidolon grows dangerous claws on its feet, allowing it to make 2 ‹umr/rake› attacks on foes it is grappling. These attacks are ‹umr/primary attack«s›. The eidolon receives these additional attacks each time it succeeds on a ‹rule/grapple› check against the target. These rake attacks deal 1d4 points of damage (1d6 if Large, 1d8 if Huge)." special="This evolution counts as one natural attack toward the eidolon's maximum."}

rend.name: Rend
description: ::ab{title="&L&Rend (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee prereq="6th-level summoner, ‹evolution/claws›" ability="An eidolon learns to rip and tear the flesh of those it attacks with its claws, gaining the ‹umr/rend› ability. Whenever the eidolon makes two successful claw attacks against the same target in 1 round, its claws latch onto the flesh and deal extra damage. This damage is equal to the damage dealt by one claw attack plus 1-1/2 times the eidolon's Strength modifier."}

rider_bond.name: Rider Bond
description: ::ab{title="&L&Rider Bond (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost-power prereq="‹evolution/Mount›" flavor="You and your eidolon share an empathic connection while you ride it." passive="You gain a bonus on Ride checks equal to ‹misc/half› your summoner level and you also gain ‹feat/Mounted Combat› as a bonus feat when mounted on your eidolon."}

shadow_blend.name: Shadow Blend
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shadow Blend (Su)&FN&" icon=def passive="In any condition of ‹rule/illumination› other than bright light, the eidolon disappears into the shadows, giving it ‹rule/concealment› (20% miss chance). If it has the ‹evolution/shadow form› evolution, it instead gains total concealment (50% miss chance). The eidolon can suspend or resume this ability as a @HLfree_action."}

shadow_form.name: Shadow Form
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shadow Form (Su)&FN&" icon=def-boost-down flavor="The eidolon's body becomes shadowy and more indistinct." ability="This shadow form grants the eidolon constant ‹rule/concealment› (20% miss chance), and its melee attacks affect incorporeal creatures as if it had the ‹magic-enh/ghost touch› weapon property. The eidolon's melee attacks deal only half damage to corporeal creatures."}

sickening.name: Sickening
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sickening (Ex)&FN&" icon=def-aura flavor="The eidolon's smell or appearance is so offensive it sickens nearby creatures." passive="Any living creature except its summoner that approaches within 20 feet or begins its turn in that area is ‹misc/sickened› for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + its Con modifier). trample.name: Trample
description: ::ab{title="&L&Trample (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee fullround="An eidolon gains the ability to crush its foes underfoot, gaining the ‹umr/trample› ability. The eidolon can overrun any creature that is at least one size smaller than itself. This works like the ‹rule/overrun› combat maneuver, but the eidolon does not need to make a check, it merely has to move over opponents in its path. The creatures take 1d6 points of damage (1d8 if Large, 2d6 if Huge), plus 1-1/2 times the eidolon's Strength modifier.~~~Targets of the trample can make attacks of opportunity at a -4 penalty. If a target forgoes the attack of opportunity, it can make a Reflex save for half damage. The DC of this save is 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Strength modifier.~~~A trampling eidolon can only deal trampling damage to a creature once per round." prereq="Biped or quadruped base form"}

tremorsense.name: Tremorsense
description: ::ab{title="&L&Tremorsense (Ex)&FN&" icon=power prereq="7th-level summoner" ability="An eidolon becomes attuned to vibrations in the ground, gaining ‹umr/tremorsense› out to a range of 30 feet. This works like the ‹evolution/blindsense› evolution, but only if both the eidolon and the creature to be pinpointed are in contact with the ground."}

trip.name: Trip
description: ::ab{title="&L&Trip (Ex)&FN&" icon=power prereq="‹evolution/Bite›" ability="An eidolon becomes adept at knocking foes to the ground with its bite, granting it a ‹rule/trip› attack. If the check fails, the eidolon is not tripped in return." special="This ability only works on creatures of a size equal to or smaller than the eidolon."}

undead_appearance.name: Undead Appearance
description: ::ab{title="&L&Undead Appearance (Ex)&FN&" icon=down-boost flavor="An eidolon appears as an undead creature, and mimics some of an undead creature's abilities and weaknesses." passive="Negative energy heals the eidolon, and positive energy (including a cleric's ‹ability/channel energy› ability) harms it. Spells and effects that target undead or have specific effects against undead (such as ‹spell/Command Undead›, ‹spell/halt undead›, and ‹spell/searing light›) affect the eidolon as if it were undead. The eidolon gains a +2 bonus on saves against disease, exhaustion, fatigue, paralysis, poison, sleep effects, and stunning." imp7="This bonus on saves can be increased to +4 by spending 2 additional evolution points." imp12="This protection can be increased to immunity against these attacks by spending 2 additional evolution points (the summoner must pay for the 7th-level upgrade before paying for this 12th-level upgrade)." special="Although the eidolon appears undead, it is still an outsider."}

weapon_training.name: Weapon Training
description: ::ab{title="&L&Weapon Training (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee ability="An eidolon learns to use a weapon, gaining ‹feat/Simple Weapon Proficiency› as a bonus feat." special="If 2 additional evolution points are spent, it gains proficiency with all martial weapons as well."}

blindsense.name: Blindsense
description: ::ab{title="&L&Blindsense (Ex)&FN&" icon=power prereq="9th-level summoner" ability="An eidolon's senses become incredibly acute, giving it ‹umr/blindsense› out to a range of 30 feet. This ability allows the eidolon to pinpoint the location of creatures that it cannot see without having to make a Perception check, but such creatures still have total ‹rule/concealment› from the eidolon." special="Visibility still affects the eidolon's movement and it is still denied its Dexterity bonus to Armor Class against attacks from creatures it cannot see."}

burrow.name: Burrow
description: ::ab{title="&L&Burrow (Ex)&FN&" icon=power prereq="9th-level summoner" ability="An eidolon grows thick and gnarled claws, allowing it to move through the earth. The eidolon gains a burrow speed equal to 1/2 its base speed. It can use this speed to move through dirt, clay, sand, and earth. It does not leave a hole behind, nor is its passage marked on the surface."}

celestial_appearance.name: Celestial Appearance
description: ::ab{title="&L&Celestial Appearance (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-def flavor="The eidolon appears as a celestial creature and manifests some of the abilities of a celestial." passive="Spells and effects that target creatures with the good subtype or have specific effects against such creatures affect the eidolon as if it were a celestial. The eidolon gains a +2 bonus on saves against disease, petrification, poison, and electricity spells and effects. It also gains spell resistance equal to 5 + its HD against spells with the evil descriptor." imp7="By spending 2 additional evolution points, this bonus on saves is increased to +4 and the spell resistance is extended to affect any spells and effects from evil creatures." imp12="By spending 2 additional evolution points, this protection is increased to immunity against these attacks and the spell resistance is increased to 11 + its HD (the summoner must pay for the 7th-level upgrade before paying for this 12th-level upgrade)." prereq="The summoner must be good-aligned"}

damage_reduction.name: Damage Reduction
description: ::ab{title="&L&Damage Reduction (Su)&FN&" icon=def prereq="9th-level summoner" flavor="An eidolon's body becomes resistant to harm, granting it damage reduction." passive="Choose one alignment: chaotic, evil, good, or lawful. The eidolon gains DR 5 that can be bypassed by weapons that possess the chosen alignment. The alignment must be opposite to one of the alignments possessed by the eidolon." imp12="This protection can be increased to DR 10 by spending 2 additional evolution points."}

fiendish_appearance.name: Fiendish Appearance
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fiendish Appearance (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-def flavor="The eidolon appears as a fiendish creature and manifests some of the abilities of a fiend." passive="Spells and effects that target creatures with the evil subtype or have specific effects against such creatures affect the eidolon as if it had that subtype. The eidolon gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against acid, disease, fire, and poison spells and effects. It also gains an amount of spell resistance equal to 5 + its HD against spells with the good descriptor." prereq="The summoner must be evil-aligned" imp7="By spending 2 additional evolution points, the summoner increases the bonus on saving throws to +4 and extends the spell resistance to affect any spells and spell-like abilities cast by good creatures." imp12="By spending 2 additional evolution points, the eidolon gains immunity to acid, disease, fire, and poison. Its spell resistance increases to an amount of equal to 11 + its HD. (The summoner must pay for the 7th-level upgrade before paying for this 12th-level upgrade.)"}

frightful_presence.name: Frightful Presence
description: ::ab{title="&L&Frightful Presence (Ex)&FN&" icon=lower prereq="11th-level summoner" ability="An eidolon becomes unsettling to its foes, gaining the ‹umr/frightful presence› ability. The eidolon can activate this ability as part of an offensive action, such as a ‹rule/charge› or attack. Opponents within 30 feet of the eidolon must make a Will save or become ‹misc/shaken› for 3d6 rounds. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Charisma modifier." special="If the eidolon has at least 4 more Hit Dice than an opponent, that opponent becomes ‹misc/frightened› instead. Foes with more HD than the eidolon are immune to this effect."}

major_magic.name: Major Magic
description: ::ab{title="&L&Major Magic (Sp)&FN&" icon=magic prereq="7th-level summoner, eidolon has charisma 12+, ‹evolution/minor magic›" flavor="An eidolon learns to cast a major spell as a spell-like ability." order=ca choice="Select one spell from the following list: ‹spell/acid arrow›, ‹spell/cure moderate wounds›, ‹spell/darkness›, ‹spell/daze monster›, ‹spell/glide›, ‹spell/invisibility› (self only), ‹spell/lesser restoration›, ‹spell/levitate›, ‹spell/minor image›, ‹spell/scorching ray›, ‹spell/see invisibility›, or ‹spell/spider climb›." ability="This spell can be cast once per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this evolution is equal to the eidolon's Hit Dice - 2. The save DC for this spell is 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Charisma modifier." imp10="This spell can be cast three times per day by spending 2 additional evolution points." special="This evolution can be selected more than once. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a new spell from the above list."}

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sacrifice (Su)&FN&" icon=aid flavor="An eidolon can sacrifice its own hit points to heal another creature." standard="The eidolon can sacrifice up to 2 hit points per Hit Die and then touch a target creature, thereby healing the creature for half the amount sacrificed."}

see_in_darkness.name: See in Darkness
description: ::ab{title="&L&See in Darkness (Su)&FN&" icon=power prereq="9th-level summoner" ability="An eidolon can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, including that created by ‹spell/deeper darkness›."}

swallow_whole.name: Swallow Whole
description: ::ab{title="&L&Swallow Whole (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee prereq="9th-level summoner, ‹evolution/grab› (bite)" ability="An eidolon gains the ‹umr/swallow whole› ability, giving it the ability to consume its foes. If the eidolon begins its turn with a creature grappled using its bite attack (see the *grab* evolution), it can attempt a combat maneuver check to swallow the creature. The creature can be up to one size category smaller than the eidolon.~~~Swallowed creatures take damage equal to the eidolon's bite damage each round plus 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage. A swallowed creature keeps the ‹rule/grappled› condition, but can attempt to cut its way free with a light slashing or piercing weapon. The amount of damage needed to cut free is equal to 1/10 the eidolon's total hit points. The eidolon's AC against these attacks is equal to 10 + 1/2 its natural armor bonus.~~~Alternatively, the swallowed creature can attempt to escape the grapple as normal. Success indicates that it has returned to the eidolon's mouth, where it can attempt to escape or be swallowed again." special="If a swallowed creature cuts its way out, the eidolon loses this ability until it heals this damage."}

web.name: Web
description: ::ab{title="&L&Web (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-zap prereq="7th-level summoner, ‹evolution/climb›" ability="An eidolon gains a pair of spinnerets, giving it the ability to spin webs. The eidolon can use these webs to support itself plus up to one creature of the same size.~~~It can throw webbing as a ranged touch attack up to 8 times per day, ‹rule/entangl«ing<ed› a creature up to one size larger than the eidolon. The webbing has a range of 50 feet and a 10-foot range increment. Creatures entangled by the web can escape with an ‹skill/Escape Artist› check or a Strength check (at a -4 penalty). The DC of these checks is equal to 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Con modifier. The webs have a Hardness of 0 and a number of hits points equal to the eidolon's total Hit Dice." special="The eidolon can climb its own webs at its climb speed and can pinpoint any creature touching its webs."}

blindsight.name: Blindsight
description: ::ab{title="&L&Blindsight (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost prereq="11th-level summoner, ‹evolution/blindsense›" ability="An eidolon's senses sharpen even further, granting it ‹umr/blindsight› out to a range of 30 feet. The eidolon can maneuver and attack as normal, ignoring darkness, invisibility, and most forms of ‹rule/concealment› as long as it has line of effect to the target."}

breath_weapon.name: Breath Weapon
description: ::ab{title="&L&Breath Weapon (Su)&FN&" order=ca icon=cone-line prereq="9th-level summoner" flavor="An eidolon learns to exhale a cone or line of magical energy, gaining a breath weapon." choice="Select either acid, cold, electricity, or fire." ability="The eidolon can breathe a 30-foot cone (or 60-foot line) that deals 1d6 points of damage of the selected type per HD it possesses. Those caught in the breath weapon can attempt a Reflex save for half damage. The DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Constitution modifier." special="The eidolon can use this ability once per day. The eidolon can use this ability 1 additional time per day by spending an additional 1 evolution point (maximum 3/day)."}

dimension_door.name: Dimension Door
description: ::ab{title="&L&Dimension Door (Sp)&FN&" icon=magic prereq="13th-level summoner, eidolon has charisma 14+" ability="An eidolon learns to cast ‹spell/dimension door› as a spell-like ability once per day. The caster level for this evolution is equal to the eidolon's Hit Dice. The save DC for this spell is 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Charisma modifier."}

fast_healing.name: Fast Healing
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fast Healing (Su)&FN&" icon=def prereq="11th-level summoner" passive="An eidolon's body gains the ability to heal wounds very quickly, giving it ‹umr/fast healing› 1. The eidolon heals 1 point of damage each round, just like natural healing. *Fast healing* does not restore hit points lost due to starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow the eidolon to regrow lost body parts (or to reattach severed parts).~~~*Fast healing* functions as long as the eidolon is alive. This *fast healing* does not function when the eidolon is not on the same plane as its summoner." special="This healing can be increased by 1 per round for every 2 additional evolution points spent (maximum 5)."}

incorporeal_form.name: Incorporeal Form
description: ::ab{title="&L&Incorporeal Form (Sp)&FN&" icon=power prereq="15th-level summoner" ability="Once per day, an eidolon can become incorporeal for 1 round per summoner level. While in this form, the eidolon gains the ‹subtype/incorporeal› subtype and ‹umr/incorporeal› quality. It only takes half damage from corporeal sources as long as they are magic (it takes no damage from nonmagical weapons and objects). Likewise, its spells or spell-like abilities deal only half damage to corporeal creatures. Spells and other effects that do not deal damage function normally."}

large.name: Large
description: ::ab{title="&L&Large (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost-def-down prereq="8th-level summoner, eidolon is Medium-sized" ability="An eidolon grows in size, becoming Large. The eidolon gains a +8 bonus to Strength, a +4 bonus to Constitution, and a +2 bonus to its natural armor. It takes a -2 penalty to its Dexterity. This size change also gives the creature a -1 size penalty to its AC and on attack rolls, a +1 bonus to its CMB and CMD, a -2 penalty on Fly skill checks, and a -4 penalty on Stealth skill checks. If the eidolon has the biped base form, it also gains 10-foot reach. Any ‹evolution/reach› evolutions the eidolon possesses are added to this total." imp13="If 6 additional evolution points are spent, the eidolon instead becomes Huge. The eidolon gains a +16 bonus to Strength, a +8 bonus to Constitution, and a +5 bonus to its natural armor. It takes a -4 penalty to its Dexterity. This size change also give the creature a -2 size penalty to its AC and attack rolls, a +2 bonus to its CMB and CMD, 10-foot reach, a -4 penalty on Fly skill checks, and a -8 penalty on Stealth skill checks. If the eidolon has the biped base form, its reach increases to 15 feet (10 feet for all other base forms). Any *reach* evolutions the eidolon possesses are added to this total. These bonuses and penalties replace, and do not stack with, those gained from becoming Large." special="The ‹evolution/ability increase› evolution costs twice as much (4 evolution points) when adding to the Strength or Constitution scores of a Large or Huge eidolon."}

lifesense.name: Lifesense
description: ::ab{title="&L&Lifesense (Su)&FN&" icon=power prereq="11th-level summoner, ‹evolution/undead appearance›" ability="An eidolon can pinpoint living creatures with ease. The eidolon notices and locates living creatures within 60 feet, just as if it possessed the ‹evolution/blindsight› evolution."}

no_breath.name: No Breath
description: ::ab{title="&L&No Breath (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-def prereq="11th-level summoner" flavor="An eidolon no longer needs to breathe." ability="The eidolon does not breathe, and is immune to effects that require breathing (such as inhaled poison). This does not give immunity to cloud or gas attacks that do not require breathing."}

spell_resistance.name: Spell Resistance
description: ::ab{title="&L&Spell Resistance (Ex)&FN&" icon=def prereq="9th-level summoner" passive="An eidolon is protected against magic, gaining spell resistance equal to 11 + the summoner's level. This spell resistance does not apply to spells cast by the summoner."}

ultimate_magic.name: Ultimate Magic
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ultimate Magic (Sp)&FN&" order=ca icon=magic prereq="11th-level summoner, eidolon has Charisma 13+, ‹evolution/major magic›" flavor="An eidolon learns to cast a powerful spell as a spell-like ability." choice="Select one spell from the following list: ‹spell/arcane sight›, ‹spell/create food and water›, ‹spell/cure serious wounds›, ‹spell/daylight›, ‹spell/fireball›, ‹spell/fly›, ‹spell/gaseous form›, ‹spell/lightning bolt›, ‹spell/major image›, ‹spell/stinking cloud›, ‹spell/tongues›, or ‹spell/water breathing›." ability="The chosen spell can be cast once per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this evolution is equal to the eidolon's Hit Dice - 2. The save DC for this spell is 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Charisma modifier." special="This evolution can be selected more than once. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a new spell from the above list."}
